original_value: AbstractIn this paper, we propose control charts for monitoring the Birnbaum‐Saunders (BS) median parameter (scale parameter) on the basis of three estimators. Comparison of the control charts in terms of average run length using probability control limits and those based on asymptotic distribution of three estimators for the median parameter is developed. We also present guidelines for practitioners about the minimum sample size needed to match out‐of‐control average run length with the asymptotic control limits in function of the median parameter after an extensive simulation study. Numerical example illustrates the applied monitoring of BS median parameter.

result.paraphrase: This paper introduces control charts for tracking the Birnbaum-Saunders (BS) median, or scale, parameter using three estimators. It compares charts based on average run length with probability control limits to those derived from the asymptotic distribution of the three median-parameter estimators. After an extensive simulation study, it also offers practitioners guidance on the minimum sample size required to align the out-of-control average run length with asymptotic control limits as a function of the median parameter. A numerical example demonstrates practical monitoring of the BS median parameter.
